description: Transforms raw data into actionable business insights using SQL, Excel, Python, and BI tools.

domains.name: SQL & Relational Databases
domains.description: Core relational query skills required for virtually every data analyst role.

subskills.name: Basic Queries & Filtering
subskills.description: SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, comparison and logical operators, aliases.
subskills.learning_objective: Write accurate single-table SELECT queries to filter, sort, and limit datasets.

subskills.name: Aggregations & GROUP BY
subskills.description: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, GROUP BY, HAVING, aggregate filters.
subskills.learning_objective: Summarize datasets with aggregate functions and produce grouped business metrics.

subskills.name: Multi-Table JOINs
subskills.description: INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, CROSS JOIN, self-joins, join conditions on foreign keys, multi-table chaining.
subskills.learning_objective: Combine data from two or more related tables using appropriate join types and produce accurate merged result sets.

subskills.name: Window Functions & CTEs
subskills.description: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG, PARTITION BY, ORDER BY in window frame, Common Table Expressions (WITH clause), recursive CTEs.
subskills.learning_objective: Apply window functions for running totals, rankings, and period comparisons without collapsing rows.

domains.name: Excel & Spreadsheets
domains.description: Spreadsheet fluency for ad-hoc analysis, reporting, and business stakeholder communication.

subskills.name: Formulas & Logical Functions
subskills.description: SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, IF / IFS, AND / OR / NOT, IFERROR, date and text functions.
subskills.learning_objective: Build dynamic formula-driven reports using conditional logic and multi-criteria aggregations.

subskills.name: Lookups & Pivot Tables
subskills.description: XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, Pivot Charts, Slicers, Power Query basics.
subskills.learning_objective: Cross-reference datasets and create self-refreshing summary dashboards for non-technical stakeholders.

domains.name: Python Data Wrangling
domains.description: Python-based data manipulation and exploratory analysis for scalable reporting pipelines.

subskills.name: Data Wrangling with Pandas
subskills.description: DataFrames, Series, read_csv/read_sql, filtering, groupby, merging/joining, reshaping, handling nulls.
subskills.learning_objective: Load, clean, and transform tabular datasets programmatically using Pandas.

subskills.name: Data Visualization
subskills.description: Matplotlib, Seaborn, bar/line/scatter/heatmap charts, labeling, storytelling with data.
subskills.learning_objective: Produce publication-quality charts that communicate analytical findings to business audiences.

domains.name: BI & Dashboards
domains.description: Business Intelligence tooling for interactive executive dashboards and self-serve analytics.

subskills.name: Data Modeling & Star Schema
subskills.description: Fact vs dimension tables, relationships, cardinality (1:M, M:M), star vs snowflake schema.
subskills.learning_objective: Design a star schema data model that supports accurate slice-and-dice analysis in a BI tool.

subskills.name: DAX & Executive Dashboards
subskills.description: Measures vs calculated columns, CALCULATE, FILTER, SUMX, time-intelligence functions, KPI visuals.
subskills.learning_objective: Author DAX measures and build interactive executive dashboards with drill-through and KPI tracking.

domains.name: Statistics & Metrics
domains.description: Statistical reasoning to validate findings, design experiments, and communicate uncertainty.

subskills.name: Descriptive Statistics & Distributions
subskills.description: Mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation, skewness, histograms, box plots.
subskills.learning_objective: Summarize and interpret data distributions to identify outliers and describe central tendency.

subskills.name: Hypothesis Testing & A/B Experiments
subskills.description: Null/alternative hypotheses, p-values, significance level, t-tests, chi-square, sample size.
subskills.learning_objective: Design and interpret a statistically valid A/B experiment and communicate results to stakeholders.
